entries.msgstr: Your team needs you! Even if your vehicle is destroyed, {whiteSpanish_Open}you will return to battle{whiteSpanish_Close} at the beginning of the {whiteSpanish_Open}next wave{whiteSpanish_Close}. Leaving the battle is considered desertion and may result in a disciplinary penalty.
